cn_title: Kathryn Newton：粉丝或能促成《蚁人4》
subtitle: 还没到终点
summary: 《蚁人3：量子狂潮》主演Kathryn Newton认为，若粉丝真心期待，系列第四部仍可能获准拍摄。她指出重启和多年后推出续集并不罕见，自己与保罗·路德将先回归《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》。
opus_summary: Kathryn Newton认为，若粉丝真心期待，《蚁人4》仍可能获准拍摄。她指出多年后推出续集并不罕见，自己与保罗·路德将先回归《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》。

paragraphs.en: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania star Kathryn Newton has said there's still hope for a fourth film in the franchise, if fans truly want it to happen.
paragraphs.cn: 《蚁人3：量子狂潮》主演Kathryn Newton表示，如果粉丝真的想看到它成真，这个系列的第四部电影仍有希望。

paragraphs.en: Speaking to The Direct , Newton suggested that the power of Marvel's fandom could still get another sequel greenlit, despite a feeling among many viewers that Quantumania was a disappointment, and that the Ant-Man franchise had run its course.
paragraphs.cn: Newton向The Direct表示，尽管许多观众认为《蚁人3：量子狂潮》令人失望，《蚁人》系列也已走到尽头，但漫威粉丝群体的力量仍可能让又一部续集获准拍摄。

paragraphs.en: Quantumania launched back in 2023, and failed to perform critically or commercially. Memorably, the movie ditched the series' previously enjoyable low-key capers for a CGI-heavy blockbuster story meant to serve as setup for Kang, the MCU's next Big Bad. (A situation unfortunately not helped further by Jonathan Majors' subsequent firing.)
paragraphs.cn: 《蚁人3：量子狂潮》于2023年上映，口碑和商业表现均告失利。值得一提的是，电影舍弃了该系列先前颇受欢迎、较为轻松低调的冒险，转而采用一段大量依赖CGI的大片故事，为漫威电影宇宙下一位大反派康铺路。（而Jonathan Majors后来被解雇，也无助于这番安排。）

paragraphs.en: Perhaps more crucially for Marvel and Disney, Quantumania was one of its most expensive films ever — and an enormous bet that did not pay off. With a budget of more than $330 million, the film struggled at the box office, and became one of the few MCU releases to not make its budget back.
paragraphs.cn: 或许对漫威和迪士尼更关键的是，《蚁人3：量子狂潮》是它们有史以来成本最高的电影之一，也是一场未能收回回报的豪赌。影片预算超过3.3亿美元(约合人民币22.3亿元)，票房表现艰难，成为少数未能收回制作成本的漫威电影宇宙作品之一。

paragraphs.en: Despite this, Newton — who plays Ant-Man's daughter Cassie Lang — has refused to rule out a fourth entry in the series happening eventually, even if it takes decades to arrive.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管如此，饰演蚁人女儿凯茜·朗的Newton仍拒绝排除系列第四部终将出现的可能性，即便它可能要等上数十年。

paragraphs.en: "I think that's not up to me, and it's up to the fans at the end of the day," Newton said. "I've always talked about the power of a fandom, and if you want something, it will happen, no matter what... If you love it, it's gonna come back around.
paragraphs.cn: Newton说：「我觉得这不取决于我，到头来取决于粉丝。我一直在谈粉丝群体的力量；只要你想要某样东西，无论如何它都会发生……如果你爱它，它总会再次回到你身边。」

paragraphs.en: "We see it all the time with things being rebooted and sequels after 20 years," she continued. "If fans want something, we listen. And that's how I felt about everything I've done."
paragraphs.cn: 她继续说道：「我们总能看到作品被重启，或是在20年后推出续集。如果粉丝想要什么，我们就会听取意见。我对自己参与过的一切都是这样看的。」

paragraphs.en: Perhaps in 20 years there will be another Ant-Man film? I suppose that is not impossible to rule out. Until then, both Newton and Ant-Man himself, Paul Rudd, will be back in Avengers: Doomsday . The latter looks to have been called up again as part of the main Avengers team, while Cassie has been spotted in a recent trailer bidding him farewell.
paragraphs.cn: 也许20年后还会有另一部《蚁人》电影？我想，这也不能完全排除。在此之前，Newton和蚁人本人保罗·路德都将回归《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》。后者看来已再度归入复仇者主力团队，而凯茜则在最近的一支预告片中被拍到向他道别。

paragraphs.en: Here's hoping Ant-Man makes it through Doomsday and Secret Wars in one piece to make a fourth film someday. Exactly what such a movie might focus on, however, is unclear. The situation is not helped by the fact that Hank Pym actor Michael Douglas has largely retired from acting, while Hope van Dyne actress Evangeline Lilly has said she's taking an "indefinite hiatus" from acting to focus on her family.
paragraphs.cn: 希望蚁人能安然熬过《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》和《复仇者联盟：秘密战争》，有朝一日拍成第四部。不过，这样一部电影究竟会聚焦什么，目前尚不清楚。饰演汉克·皮姆的迈克尔·道格拉斯已基本淡出演艺界；饰演霍普·凡·戴恩的伊万杰琳·莉莉则表示，自己将「无限期暂别」演艺工作，专注于家庭，这也令情况更为复杂。

paragraphs.en: Cassie, meanwhile, is expected to eventually join the Young Avengers team being created by Ms. Marvel and Kate Bishop — if Marvel ever gets around to returning to those characters.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，人们预计凯茜最终会加入由惊奇女士和凯特·毕肖普筹建的少年复仇者团队——前提是漫威有朝一日愿意回头继续讲述这些角色的故事。
